title: Villa Vie Odyssey cruise ship leaves Cambodia after suspending operations
summary: The cruise ship Villa Vie Odyssey left the Sihanoukville Autonomous Port in Cambodia shortly after midnight on Wednesday (November 4), after more than a week docked there.
